violation_type.title: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs
violation_type.typical_finding: During today's inspection a three year old child was observed in a playyard with toys and a blanket. The permit holder stated the child is placed in the playyard because they are too active.

finding_variants.text: During today's inspection a three year old child was observed in a playyard with toys and a blanket. The permit holder stated the child is placed in the playyard because they are too active.
During the inspection children were observed running around the room, some were sleeping, and one was crying and wondering around the house.
The children were observed out control, children were running around the house, outside the home and getting on furniture.
Chilldren were observed during today's inspection  running around in main room of the house climbing on toys yelling, crying and going in and out of the backdoor leading to the backyard of the home.
During inspection children were not following program schedule, they were observed running around and jumping on beds.
The children were observed to be running all throughout the home and jumping off of the fire place and chairs.
